'''''Lotus angustissimus''''', the '''slender bird's foot trefoil''', is a plant in the genus ''[[Lotus (genus)|Lotus]]''. It has a wide distribution, from [[Macaronesia]] to [[Xinjiang]] in China.<ref name=POWO_503465-1>{{Cite POWO|last=POWO |date=2024 |title=''Lotus angustissimus'' L.|id=503465-1|access-date=2024-08-13|mode=cs1}}</ref>

== Description ==
This plant is an annual identified by hairy red stems, singular yellow flowers looking like those of common vetch, and leaves are oval with spear tips. This plant creates mats on the ground and blooms July to August.<ref name = calflora>{{Calflora |1=''Lotus angustissimus'' |id=5019 |access-date=2024-08-12 }}</ref> This plant has unique reddish seeds.<ref>{{Cite PLANTS |symbol=LOAN2 |taxon=Lotus angustissimus |access-date=2024-08-12}}</ref>

== Distribution ==
''Lotus angustissimus'' has a wide distribution from [[Macaronesia]], [[North Africa]], [[Europe]] and [[West Asia]] to the [[Caucasus]], [[Kazakhstan]], [[Western Siberia]] and [[Xinjiang]].<ref name=POWO_503465-1/> It has been introduced elsewhere, including [[California]],<ref name=POWO_503465-1/> where it is considered a [[weed]].<ref name=calflora/>
